question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Remarkable.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage the correct option to be filled in the blank is Remarkable.
 
• Remarkable: Unusual or exceptional, hence startling and noteworthy.
 
 
• Example: Mother Teresa was a truly remarkable woman. *
 
 
 
• *​​*Therefore the correct option is Remarkable.

​The complete sentence is:** John Metcalfe was one of the most remarkable road builders of this period. He was blind and felt the surface of the road.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Credulous **refers to being too trusting of what you are told and being so easily duped.
 
• **Fascinated **refers to something that is extremely interesting.
 
• **Attentive **refers to someone who is listening carefully. ** **
